summary: The root نطف (nTf) refers to a type of sweetmeat, similar to "qubbayṭā." It's a confection, often sticky or syrupy.
lane: نَاطِفٌ ذ A kind of sweetmeat; (Msb;) i. q. قُبَّيْطَى . (S, Msb.)
